custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior of the mouth. AI models often fail to render the tongue or throat correctly when a bird's beak is open, resulting in a smooth, undefined cavity. Also, verify if the comb's texture looks like biological tissue or synthetic rubber.
